title: Stage representation of normalized component
statement: For every stage $L$ containing the stage of $P$, the normalized common-stage compositor component at $P$ (the localized integral compositor at the stage of $P$, conjugated by the literal object equalities) equals, up to those equalities, the pair-category arrow represented at $L$ by $c^{-1}\circ f^*_L(c_g^{-1})\circ\rho_P\circ c_{gf}$, built from the rational compositor at $L$ and the recorded pullback comparisons.

proof.text: Both sides are arrows of the pair category between the same literal objects. Enlarging the stage-$P$ representative to $L$ applies the coefficient transition, conjugated by the recorded stage-transition identifications. Scalar-extension compatibility of integral pullback [lem-pod-pullback-identities-scalar-extension] carries the stage-$P$ compositor to the stage-$L$ compositor conjugated by the rational pullback scalar comparisons of $gf$, $f$, $g$; the compositor is pinned by its finite reductions [lem-pod-integral-pullback-composition], so the two agree. Those comparisons with the transition identifications are the recorded pullback comparisons [def-weil-common-stage-pullback-data], and the literal equality transports cancel by proof irrelevance.

lean.statement:
theorem commonStagePullbackCompComponent_stage_representation
    {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)]
    [∀ z : Z, Invertible (l : Z.residueField z)]
    (P : generalAlgebraicallyClosedConstructibleCategory l Ω Z)
    (L : AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Index l Ω) (hP : P.stage ≤ L) :
    HEq (commonStagePullbackCompComponent l Ω f g P).hom
      (GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.ofHom
        (commonStagePullbackObject l Ω (f ≫ g) P)
        (commonStagePullbackObject l Ω f
          (commonStagePullbackObject l Ω g P)) L hP hP
        ((commonStagePullbackComparison l Ω (f ≫ g) P L hP).hom ≫
          (commonStagePullbackRationalComposition l Ω f g L P hP).hom ≫
          (rationalDerivedPullback l
            (AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Coefficient.{u} l Ω L) f).map
            ((commonStagePullbackComparison l Ω g P L hP).inv) ≫
          (commonStagePullbackComparison l Ω f
            (commonStagePullbackObject l Ω g P) L hP).inv))
